messages:
maggie: follow-up from the 03/18 latency postmortem. proposal: add a short triage checklist item for model-variant fallback + prefix/KV cache checks, include safe command snippets, and formalize escalation: oncall -> runtime -> platform within 30m.

devon: +1. add model-variant fallback check (we saw this repeat).

maggie: ordering suggestion: 1) confirm scope (customers/models), 2) model-variant fallback, 3) prefix/KV cache, 4) autoscaler backlog, 5) fallback to smaller model.

samir: owners/timelines: devon edits runbook (PR by EOD Tue), anya builds automation tests (7 days), lisa updates escalation diagram and contacts (EOW). I'll make tracking ticket and verify.

anya: for automation tests please include exact commands to assert cache health.

maggie: suggested command snippets (copy-paste safe):
redwoodctl cache inspect --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --show-stats
redwoodctl cache flush --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --confirm   # DANGER: use only if corrupt
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz

devon: good. I'll add example outputs and a clear "DANGER" callout for flush in my PR.

lisa: escalation detail: hard 30-min SLA to tag runtime, explicit phone/SMS for after-hours. I'll update contact list.

maggie: also add a checkbox in postmortem template for "matches known pattern" (cache thrash, autoscaler oversubscribe, tokenization edgecase). if checked, route to Pattern Owners and schedule deeper RCA.

samir: creating ticket: INCIDENT-4921 "SOP: cache & fallback triage + escalation diagram" assigned to samir, due 2026-03-25. I'll link runbook PR.

anya: small nit: include sample output for `redwoodctl cache inspect` so oncall knows expected shape.

devon: will include sample output and troubleshooting note (hit_rate, eviction_count).

maggie: recap owners: devon (runbook PR) EOD Tue, anya (tests) 7 days, lisa (escalation/contacts) EOW, samir (ticket/verify) tomorrow. I'll post a checklist in incidents board. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder: Created task INCIDENT-4921 "SOP tweaks: cache/fallback triage + escalation diagram" assigned to samir, due 2026-03-25.

lisa: noted, will update calendar and contacts.

samir: thanks — will post the tracking link once created.

maggie: closing thread, will re-open if blockers. :thumbsup:
